  function renorm(s, e) { const z = s + e; return [z, e - (z - s)]; }
  function ddAdd(a, b) { const s = a[0] + b[0]; const v = s - a[0]; const e = (a[0] - (s - v)) + (b[0] - v) + a[1] + b[1]; return renorm(s, e); }
  function ddNeg(a) { return [-a[0], -a[1]]; }
  function ddSub(a, b) { return ddAdd(a, ddNeg(b)); }
  function ddMul(a, b) { const p = a[0] * b[0]; const splitter = 134217729; const ca = splitter * a[0]; const cb = splitter * b[0]; const ah = ca - (ca - a[0]); const al = a[0] - ah; const bh = cb - (cb - b[0]); const bl = b[0] - bh; const e = (((ah * bh - p) + ah * bl) + al * bh) + al * bl + a[0] * b[1] + a[1] * b[0]; return renorm(p, e); }
  function ddCmp(a, b) { if (a[0] < b[0]) return -1; if (a[0] > b[0]) return 1; if (a[1] < b[1]) return -1; if (a[1] > b[1]) return 1; return 0; }
  function stateAt(t) { const tt = [t, 0]; let lo = 0; let hi = EVENTS.length; while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (ddCmp(tt, EVENTS[mid].t) >= 0) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid; } const e = EVENTS[lo === 0 ? 0 : lo - 1]; const dt = ddSub(tt, e.t); const dt2 = ddMul(dt, dt); const x = ddAdd(e.px, ddMul(e.vx, dt)); const y = ddAdd(ddAdd(e.py, ddMul(e.vy, dt)), ddMul(HALF_G, dt2)); return [x[0] + x[1], y[0] + y[1]]; }
  function simulate(t) { return stateAt(Number(t)); }
  globalThis.simulate = simulate;
  const canvas = document.getElementById("canvas"); const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const vertices = [[1,0],[0.25,0.95],[-0.85,0.52],[-0.78,-0.62],[0.4,-0.88]]; const sx = 180; const sy = -180; const ox = 400; const oy = 250;
  function tx(p) { return [ox + sx * p[0], oy + sy * p[1]]; }
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 800, 500); ctx.beginPath();
  vertices.forEach((p, i) => { const q = tx(p); if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(q[0], q[1]); else ctx.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); });
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle = "#e8eef8"; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#243b64"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
  const b = tx([0.10, 0.30]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b[0], b[1], 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fillStyle = "#d43b3b"; ctx.fill();
})();
</script>
</body>
